title: Chilli lime squid
summary: Chilli lime squid is a mexican dinner built around squid rings and red peppers, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat squid rings dry and season it. Prep red peppers and lime juice for Chilli lime squid so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook squid rings on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook red peppers and lime juice in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Chilli lime squid before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice squid rings and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.

image.alt: Chilli lime squid served for dinner
